description: Validate check digits: Luhn card numbers (with brand), IBAN mod-97, ISBN-10/13 and EAN/UPC barcodes. Format only — nothing is looked up or stored. Operations: "validate" — Validate a number, auto-detecting its type or using the one you choose.; "check-digit" — Compute the Luhn or GS1 (EAN/UPC) check digit to append to a payload.. Call with "operation" plus "input" (and "options" where relevant).

input.description: validate: A card number, IBAN, ISBN or EAN/UPC (spaces and dashes are ignored). check-digit: The digits without their check digit.

operation.description: validate — Validate a number, auto-detecting its type or using the one you choose. check-digit — Compute the Luhn or GS1 (EAN/UPC) check digit to append to a payload.

options.description: Options for the chosen operation (each says which operations use it).

algorithm.description: luhn (cards, IMEI) or gs1 (EAN/UPC/GTIN). Used by: check-digit.

type.description: Which check to run. Used by: validate.

name: luhn
title: Luhn, IBAN & ISBN Validator
